title: Mirexis demo released!
author: Kalaith
selftext:
I've been working on this project for a few months. It's not too deep yet, trying not to go content-heavy at the start just because AI can.

Overall, this has been a fun project to work on. I have plenty of further development ideas for a long tail of updates, but atm it needs a solid campaign first and **a lot** of play testing.

https://webhatchery.itch.io/mirexis

The demo is WebGL and will run in most browsers. You can download the full game without paying anything. I need play testers more than earning money for it.

If it got to a full release, I would create a Steam page.

Blurb from itch.io

Mirexis is a turn-based tactical RPG about a small human colony trapped in the middle of an alien war.

Lead a band of colonists through grid-based battles, rescue survivors, build your settlement, research new capabilities, and manage pressure from three powerful rival factions. Your people are changing under the influence of alien biology and technology and those mutations may be the only thing keeping them alive.

Every operation feeds back into the colony. Recruits persist, relationships develop, faction pressure grows, and enemy attacks threaten everything you have built.
